```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, sf, tmap, httr)
```

```{r}
folder_path <- "data"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "^ACRA*.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

acra_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
```

```{r}
#|eval: false
#|echo: false
write_rds(acra_data,
          "data/acra_data.rds")
```

```{r}
biz_56111_55101_56130 <- acra_data %>%
  select(1:24) %>%
  filter(primary_ssic_code %in% c(56111, 55101, 56130)) %>%
  rename(date = registration_incorporation_date) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         YEAR = year(date),
         MONTH_NUM = month(date),
         MONTH_ABBR = month(date,
                      label = TRUE,
                      abbr = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate( 
    postal_code = str_pad(postal_code,
    width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>%
           filter(YEAR == 2025)
```

```{r}
postcodes <- unique(biz_56111_55101_56130$postal_code)

url <- "https://onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search"

found <- data.frame()
not_found <- data.frame(postcode = character())

for (pc in postcodes) {
  query <- list(
    searchVal = pc,
    returnGeom = "Y",
    getAddrDetails = "Y",
    pageNum = "1"
  )
  
  res <- GET(url, query = query)
  json <- content(res)
  
  if (json$found != 0) {
    df <- as.data.frame(json$results, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$input_postcode <- pc
    found <- bind_rows(found, df)
  } else {
    not_found <- bind_rows(not_found, data.frame(postcode = pc))
  }
}    
```

```{r}
found <- found %>%
  select(1:10)
```

```{r}
biz_56111_55101_56130 = biz_56111_55101_56130 %>%
  left_join(found,
            by = c('postal_code' = 'POSTAL'))
```

```{r}
write_rds(biz_56111_55101_56130, "data/biz_56111_55101_56130.rds")
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
biz_56111_55101_56130_sf_firsthalf2025 <- biz_56111_55101_56130_sf %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2025, MONTH_NUM %in% 1:6)
```

```{r}
split_list <- split(biz_56111_55101_56130_sf_firsthalf2025, 
                    biz_56111_55101_56130_sf_firsthalf2025$primary_ssic_code)

biz_56111_sf_firsthalf2025 <- split_list[["56111"]]
biz_55101_sf_firsthalf2025 <- split_list[["55101"]]
biz_56130_sf_firsthalf2025 <- split_list[["56130"]]
```

```{r}
biz_56111_sf_firsthalf2025 <- st_transform(biz_56111_sf_firsthalf2025, 
                              crs = 3414)
biz_55101_sf_firsthalf2025 <- st_transform(biz_55101_sf_firsthalf2025, 
                              crs = 3414)
biz_56130_sf_firsthalf2025 <- st_transform(biz_56130_sf_firsthalf2025, 
                              crs = 3414)
```
